title: Embedding & Reranking: PII-safe logging, retention, and auditable events
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Embeddings and reranking endpoints ingest user text that may contain PII. Current request/response logging and short-term retention for debugging and model quality telemetry risk exposing sensitive tokens in logs and audit trails. Goal: Implement a set of engineering controls to minimize PII exposure while preserving debugging and quality workflows for embeddings and reranking workloads.
acceptance_criteria: 1) No plaintext PII stored in central logs or long-term telemetry for embeddings/rerank requests by default. 2) Customers can enable safe debug logging with explicit opt-in and RBAC. 3) Retention windows configurable per-tenancy with immutable audit events for enable/disable actions. 4) Audit trail shows who accessed raw payloads and when. 5) End-to-end tests and load tests prove latency impact <= 5% for typical 512-token embedding batches.
design_decisions: - Default: redact PII-sensitive fields before persisting logs or telemetry. Redaction strategy uses deterministic token hashing with salt per-tenant to allow downstream uniqueness tests without revealing raw text. - Opt-in raw logging requires tenant-level flag, SSO group approval, and KMS-backed ephemeral storage with automatic purge. - Audit events include actor, action, resource, timestamp, and justification; these are immutable and retained per tenant policy. - We will not ship automatic PII detection ML model in this sprint; use conservative regex + heuristic extractor to classify high-risk tokens, with roadmap item to replace with model-based classifier.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (this sprint): implement redaction middleware in embeddings and rerank endpoints to apply per-tenant config; add deterministic salted hashing library; wire audit event producer. Phase 2: add admin UI in Console for opt-in raw logging and retention settings; integrate KMS-based encryption for raw traces. Phase 3: rollout canary to 5% of tenants and run workload tests. Phase 4: full rollout + post-rollout audit and runbook.
api_changes: - New query params/header: X-Redwood-Log-Mode: redact|hash|raw-optin. - New admin API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/logging with body {"raw_logging": true, "retention_days": 7, "approved_by": "string"}. These endpoints require tenant admin role and audit justification.
metrics_and_monitoring: Track metrics: redaction_rate, raw_log_enabled_count, audit_events_emitted, latency_p50/95/99 for embeddings/rerank, failed_redactions. Alerts: failed_redactions > 0.1% sustained triggers PagerDuty. Monitor KMS errors and storage purge success rate.
security_considerations: - KMS-protect raw payloads and store in ephemeral, timeboxed buckets. - RBAC: only users with 'tenant_admin' + 'raw_log_approver' can enable raw logs. - Audit events immutable and forwarded to customer-owned SIEM if configured. - Ensure redact/hash runs before any structured extraction to avoid leaking substrings.
testing_plan: Unit tests for redaction and hashing with edge cases (unicode, long sequences, separators). Integration tests for header flows. Performance bench: embedding batches of 128 and 512 items at p50/p95 token lengths. Security review checklist and penetration test for storage and retrieval flows.
rollout_strategy: Canary 5% tenants for 48h, monitor latency and failed_redactions. Extend to 25% if stable for 72h. Require checklist signoff from Security and Compliance before 100%.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false positives in redaction could remove signal for reranking. Mitigation: use hash mode to preserve uniqueness for downstream quality loops. Risk: latency regression from hashing and KMS; mitigation: async KMS envelope encryption and local cache for per-tenant salts.
open_questions: 1) Should we provide SDK helpers to perform client-side PII masking? 2) For deterministic salt rotation, what is the retention/rotation policy? 3) Does legal require different default retention for EU tenants?
next_steps: 1) Security to approve KMS design (SEC-89). 2) PM to finalize admin UI wireframes (link below). 3) Eng to implement redaction middleware and deterministic hashing. 4) Add e2e tests in CI and perf harness. 5) Schedule canary window.
